name: Know Yourself
author: Ankur Raina
summary: Uses a company's internal records to answer questions, prepare meeting briefings, and report changes in its business position.
starterPrompt: Help me choose the company records needed for reliable internal briefings. List required access and cite the records behind each answer.
usageNote: Connect only authorized company systems and keep access as narrow as possible. Verify outputs against the underlying records before sharing confidential information.
